remarks:
Nine-acre lot with 484 feet frontage on Remsen, situated on dry land, suitable for agriculture or for building. An additional 8.2 acres of land are available adjoining this lot (see B1649806), making for an exciting 17.2 acre development opportunity in the Town of Pembroke! Prime for parceling off multiple building lots (with planning board approval). Water quality is excellent and a future water district is being planned by the Town of Pembroke. Electric is already at the road.

A rural setting yet close to the Village of Akron and conveniently located between Buffalo and Batavia. Akron Schools.
